_doc: The vector stars drawn over a nebula sky, and how they streak (nebula-skies design 5). Each star is a direction at infinity; every frame it is drawn as a line from where it is on screen now back toward where it was tail_s ago, so a turning view smears the stars into short lines (FreeSpace's way: the star's last position kept, a line drawn to it, its length capped and its brightness dimmed as it grows). A star's class sets its brightness range (the sky file holds each star's own) and its head's size at rest; its colour is a tint. streak: tail_s the seconds of turning a tail shows, max_deg the longest tail (angle), min_px the least line drawn (a star at rest is a point), dim_per_deg the brightness lost per degree of tail and dim_floor the least kept (FreeSpace 2's 7,800 per unit and 75 of 255), tail_fade the tail end's share of the head's brightness, cut_deg_s a turn faster than this is a camera cut (no tail that frame). motes: patrol-mission 11.4's dust round the eye, drawn by the same streak rule from eye-space points, so moving forward fast shows. Colours sRGB 0-1.
